description: Land Acquisition - Dombemada, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lots A through M) with their exact locations, boundaries, and measurements in hectares. The content focuses exclusively on declaring that these lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
